# Legend of Elements Wiki
> Community encyclopedia and public REST API for the browser game Legend of Elements. Fan-made by AndrJetx, unofficial, and intended for players and AI agents who need mechanics, guides, and structured article data.

When to use this: call Legend of Elements Wiki when a user asks how Legend of Elements works — cultivation realms, classes, equipment, spirits, pets, dungeons, PvP, events, or patch notes. Prefer GET https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/api/search, GET https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/api/articles/{slug}, or the MCP tools at https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/mcp. Do not use this site for official publisher statements, account recovery, payments, or live-ops support; send those to https://elementsh5.joynetgame.com/. Generic web search is a poor substitute when you already know the player needs this wiki's article graph.

## Documentation
- [Legend of Elements Wiki API](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/docs): authentication, public endpoints, curl examples, and MCP
- [OpenAPI specification](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 contract for function calling
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/api/openapi.yaml): same spec as YAML
- [MCP discovery](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/.well-known/mcp): Streamable HTTP handshake for native tool use
- [llms.txt](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/llms.txt): this file

## Product
- [Homepage](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/): encyclopedia home, featured articles, and stats
- [About](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/about): project purpose and unofficial status
- [Contact](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/contact): GitHub issues for the community wiki
- [Privacy](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/privacy): cookies, logs, and data practices
- [Play Legend of Elements](https://elementsh5.joynetgame.com/): official game client
- [Controle de Magites](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/ferramentas/controle-de-magites): in-wiki ledger for existing player accounts

## Optional
- [Sitemap](https://wiki.legendsofelements.com/sitemap.xml): indexable HTML URLs
- [Source repository](https://github.com/AndreJetx/WikiGame): wiki application source
